description: Read several public web pages in one batch call, each as a clean AIDocument. Up to 20 URLs, faster than calling read_url repeatedly. Use it to compare or summarize multiple pages at once; a failed URL is reported per-item and does not block the others. Powered by Lyrenth.

fresh.description: Force a fresh fetch for all URLs instead of cached versions. Slower; default false.

max_tokens.description: Cap each returned document to roughly this many tokens.

name: read_urls
title: Read URLs (batch)
